objective: Align structural research, discovery breadth, statistical power and promotion with realizable compounded EUR200 Pepperstone/cTrader equity growth while preserving free margin, recovery capacity and anti-ruin constraints.

live_universe.note: These are the persisted LIVE-authority counts at the reconciled research HEAD; broader architecture does not depend on the small count drift from prior external snapshots.

structural_panel_conflation.finding: The 41-symbol structural coverage panel repeatedly became the inferential discovery panel without authority that structural signature implies behavioral or economic equivalence.
evidence: Registry selection is outcome-blind and appropriate for broker-topology coverage.
Epoch35 and Epoch36 each processed all 41 exactly once while also declaring representatives_are_economic_equivalents=false.
Cross-sectional inference is especially sensitive because peer-universe definition is part of the estimand.

statistical_power.method: Exact binomial power audit using each symbol's observed chronological-half eligible-date counts. Reported power requires both halves to independently reject a one-sided p=0.5 sign null. The Bonferroni column is a conservative multiplicity reference, not a claim that BH equals Bonferroni.
interpretation: M5 bar count is not effective independent sample size for event-based sign tests; the independent unit used by Epoch35/36 is approximately an eligible UTC date within each chronological half.
Both-half requirements can be scientifically useful for stability, but used as an early discovery gate they create very high false-negative probability for moderate effects.
Multiplicity protection must remain, but exploratory discovery and confirmatory error control should not be conflated.
Pooled, hierarchical, clustered or portfolio-level estimands are appropriate when the economic object is a diversified portfolio effect and the design supports those estimands.

epoch30.interpretation: This is broad corrected structural evidence of repeatable session-time activity structure, not direct economic alpha.
epoch30.defect: No explicit rapid legal promotion path converted the broad family-level structural result into a fresh, prospectively defined confirmatory/economic research question. Per-symbol winners also cannot simply be cherry-picked after observation.

required_fix: Promote broad structural evidence at the mechanism/family level into a fresh prospective follow-on question, without selecting observed winning tickers as the new economic universe.
Define independent/protected confirmation and cost/margin gates before opening economics.
Measure opportunity density, turnover, capital utilization, concurrency and friction early enough to prioritize economically useful research.

objective_alignment.finding: Per-symbol corrected significance is evidence, not the competition objective.
objective_alignment.prohibited_shortcut: Do not replace statistical rigor with blind brute-force economic testing.

answers_to_required_questions.why_41_became_discovery_panel: Shared 13-week data were complete for all 41 representatives and the fast-path machinery repeatedly reused that convenient, deterministic coverage surface. Convenience and topology coverage were allowed to become implicit inferential scope.
